evidence.method: PRODUCTION CMC JOINT CENTRE: the Stage-4A approved CMC SURFACE cage anchor (vertex 794) is kept as the region authority, not as the joint centre.  Along the anchor's own local surface normal the interior chord is measured and the maximum-clearance point of that chord is taken (unified medial rule).  Cross-checked with the first-metacarpal axial section medial centre.  The result is clamped to the approved CMC cage locality sphere (R = 15.64 mm euclidean) and never claims a CMC deformation verdict.

approved T-01 THUMB_MCP axial zone is KEPT (the plane through the R1 landmark normal to the thumb's first-metacarpal axis); within that plane the centre is the maximum-clearance point (largest inscribed sphere centre) of the thumb cross-section.

IP.tail_note: the tail (= the fingertip landmark) necessarily follows the requalified THUMB_TIP_R head; the IP JOINT (head) is unchanged

evidence.method: THUMB_FINGERTIP_LANDMARK.  (1) candidate set = thumb-owned skin samples (vertices AND face centroids, so the coarse 8-vertex distal cap cannot quantise the result) lying within the measured distal-phalanx envelope R_env(thumb) = %.2f mm of the THUMB_IP bone segment - the same envelope the approved nail selector uses; the tube restriction is essential because without it the farthest thumb point from the IP joint would be the carpo-metacarpal region;  (2) the landmark is the FARTHEST such candidate whose straight line from the THUMB_IP joint stays inside the thumb at every interior sample, so the resulting IP->TIP bone actually runs inside the digit.

segments.authority: R2 MCP centre + frozen R1 IP centre
frozen R1 IP centre + R2 fingertip landmark

criterion: every sample at t in [0.05, 0.85] of every thumb segment must be inside the mesh (the distal endpoint is a SKIN point by construction, exactly as for the four accepted finger landmarks, so it is excluded); each segment length must be >= its approved T-01 axial span and <= 1.6x it (a projection can only shorten); no inter-segment kink above 60 deg; the fingertip landmark must be within 1.5 mm of the thumb skin; and the thumb IP->TIP interior fraction must be at least the MINIMUM measured on the four already-accepted finger DIP->TIP segments (self-calibrating control, no invented threshold).  No anatomical average length is hard-coded.
